key_insight: MAPLE is a memory-augmented optimization agent that keeps executable state across successive natural-language updates, enabling dynamic problem revision instead of one-off solution generation.
engineering_relevance: It is relevant for real operational systems where requirements change over time, because it can preserve prior decisions and reuse search information while adapting constraints, objectives, and data.
method: Combines language-based problem construction with mathematical programming and evolutionary search.
Stores the optimization program, accepted plans, earlier updates, and candidate solutions for future requests.
Uses this retained state to validate updates and accelerate adaptation across evolving trajectories.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on NLDO with 15 trajectories and 180 updates across selection, scheduling, rostering, routing, and cloud-resource placement; MAPLE completed all trajectories and achieved online scalar quality 0.951 and Pareto hypervolume ratio 0.875.
watch_item: Performance depends on maintaining consistent executable state, so implementation complexity and robustness of state reuse across major problem revisions are key concerns.
paper_title: MAPLE: Memory-Augmented Planning with Language and Evolution
